ordinance: Village of Green Oaks IL Village Code Title 8 Zoning (amlegal greenoaksil, current through Ord. 2026-O-09 passed 7-22-2026; fetched 2026-10-14)

SR-5.quote: §8-5A-2 'The only uses permitted are: Accessory uses. ...' (single-family/agricultural list; no storage, warehouse or industrial use).

SR-2.quote: §8-5B-2 'The only uses permitted are: Accessory uses. Agriculture on a minimum of five (5) acres ... Cemetery. Private stable ... Single-family detached dwellings, one per lot. ...'

SR-1.5.quote: §8-5C-2 'The only uses permitted are: A. Single-family detached dwellings, one per lot. B. Agriculture on a minimum of five (5) acres and subject to the restrictions for any SR-2 District ...'

SR-1.quote: §8-5D-1 'No building, structure or premises shall be used ... within any SR-1 District ... except in conformity with the regulations established for any SR-2 District as set forth in Article B of this Chapter ...' §8-5B-2 'The only uses permitted are: Accessory uses. Agriculture on a minimum of five (5) acres ... Cemetery. Private stable ... Single-family detached dwellings, one per lot. ...'

SR-1A.quote: §8-5E-1 'No building, structure or premises shall be used ... within any SR-1A District ... except in conformity with the regulations established for any SR-2 District ... and SR-1 District ...' §8-5B-2 'The only uses permitted are: Accessory uses. Agriculture on a minimum of five (5) acres ... Cemetery. Private stable ... Single-family detached dwellings, one per lot. ...'

AG.quote: §8-6-4 PERMITTED USES: 'Accessory uses. Agriculture, only the following uses are permitted under the term "Agriculture": A. Apiary; B. Cultivation of field and garden crops C. Flower farm D. Livestock raising ...'

CB.quote: §8-7C-8(A)(2) private special uses: '... Contractor's equipment storage yard ... Truck, trailer rental Warehouse, self-storage or mini-warehouse.'
CB.notes: Named special use => permitted under owner policy. Industrial/warehouse not in the CB permitted list (§8-7C-4 'Permitted principal uses shall only be the following'). Not present on the village layer.

GB.quote: §8-7D-4 'Permitted principal uses shall only be the following. Unless noted, all permitted principal uses shall be indoor uses.' (retail/service list; the only storage-related entry is 'Rental of equipment with indoor storage.'); the §8-7D-8 special-use list names no self-storage, mini-warehouse or warehouse.
GB.notes: Closed list; self-storage is named in CB/LI/II (special) and GI (permitted) but not in GB.

HC.quote: §8-4-1 lists 'HC | Highway Commercial' but Title 8 contains no HC article or use regulations.
HC.notes: Listed-only district; not on the village layer; unresolved.

CR.quote: §8-4-1 lists 'CR | Commercial Recreation' but Title 8 contains no CR article or use regulations.
CR.notes: Listed-only district; not on the village layer; unresolved.

LI.quote: §8-7A-4(A) 'Permitted principal uses upon any property in the Limited Industrial (LI) Zoning District within the Village shall only be the following: ... Industrial use, including, but not limited to: assembly, ... storage and testing ... Warehouse (excluding self-storage or miniwarehouse).' §8-7A-8(A)(2)(a) private special uses: '... Warehouse, self-storage or miniwarehouse.'
LI.notes: Definitional carve-out on the by-right warehouse + self-storage NAMED as a special use in the same district => permitted (owner policy). §8-7A-8(B)(24)(b): 'A site for such a use shall not exceed three (3) acres when the only use is the self-storage warehouse or miniwarehouse use ... except ... part of a mixed use project that includes retail uses'.

GI.quote: §8-7E-4 'Permitted principal uses shall only be the following. ... Industrial use, including, but not limited to: assembly, ... storage and testing ... Warehouse. Warehouse, self-storage or miniwarehouse 7 . ... Wholesaling and storage of goods or materials.'
GI.notes: Self-storage permitted BY RIGHT. §8-7E-4-1(8)(b): 'A site for such a use shall not exceed three (3) acres.'

II.quote: §8-7B-4 'Permitted principal uses shall only be the following: ... Industrial use, including but not limited to: assembly, ... storage and testing ... Warehouse (excluding self-storage or mini-warehouse).' §8-7B-8(A) private special uses: '... Truck, trailer rental. Warehouse, self-storage or mini-warehouse.'
II.notes: II = Intensive Industrial (NOT Institutional). Named special use => permitted (owner policy). §8-7B-8(B)(19)(b): 'A site for such a use shall not exceed three (3) acres.'

O.quote: §8-7-5-4 '... No portion of any lot shall be used for open or unenclosed storage. Permitted principal uses shall only be the following: A. Offices, business, professional and institutional tenants. B. Offices, governmental. C. Medical offices and laboratories. D. Real estate offices. E. Financial institution ... F. Business or professional schools. G. Conference centers.'
O.notes: Layer code 'O-SU' (Office - Special Use) binds here.

I.quote: §8-4-1 'I | Institutional'. §8-7F-4 'Permitted principal uses shall only be the following: Agriculture. Botanical garden. Public open land, refuge or preserve.'

MX.quote: §8-7G-4(A) 'Permitted principal uses shall only be the following: Agriculture. Commercial or industrial uses but only as a part of an approved special use for a mixed-use development.' §8-7G-6(B) 'Permitted special uses shall only be the following: Mixed-use development.'
MX.notes: Industrial only via a mixed-use-development special use => light_industrial conditional. Self-storage not named and warehouse not by right => ss/mw prohibited (closed list); it could arrive only through an approved MXD use list (§8-7G-6(B)(3)(c)).
